title: 35th Annual It's A Gas Swap Meet!
seo_title: 35th Annual It's A Gas Swap Meet in Lebanon, MO
description: This is a swap meet where vendors sell petrolania, vintage advertising, nostalgia, coin-op items, vintage toys, gas pumps, and other items tied to the gas and oil collector's hobby. It takes place Friday, February 12, 2027 at 8:00 AM at the Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street in Lebanon, Missouri.
